label: ser / estar
en: to be: what it is / where it is now
note: ser: who or what it is. estar: where it is, how it is now.
Es médico. Está en casa. Está cansado.

sentences.en: Luke, I am your cousin.
She is in the bathroom.
She is my dream girl.
Tom is in his office.
He's a good person.
Japan is close to China.
Bill is my best friend.
This city is in France.

label: hay
note: There is / there are. One form for one or many.
hay: Hay un libro. Hay dos libros.

sentences.en: There are no classes in August.
There's a lot of snow in the winter.
Between us there is no problem.
There's a math test tomorrow.
There is no time to be lost.

label: ir a
note: Going to do something: the near future.
ir a + verb: Voy a comer.

sentences.en: That won't happen.
What will you give her?
He won't like that.
You will miss the train.
I'm going to take my car.
That won't work.
I'll show you something.

label: tener que
note: Have to do something: an obligation.
tener que + verb: Tengo que ir.

sentences.en: I need to go into town.
I have to go home.
She doesn't need to work.
I must open the window.
We must help.
Do I have to change my diet?
Do we have to take the bus?

label: muy / mucho
note: muy + quality word; mucho after a verb or before a noun.
muy alto; Llovió mucho. Comen mucho pescado.

sentences.en: This road is very long.
The dinner was very good.
I'm very glad to see you.
We have a very serious problem.
I like her sister very much.
We had a lot of rain last month.
Do Japanese eat a lot of fish?

label: acabar de
note: Has just done something.
acabar de + verb: Acabo de llegar.

sentences.en: It just got better!
Did you just realize that?
Something just occurred to me.
It began raining just now.
Life has just begun.
What just happened there?
I just turned in my application.

label: gustar
note: Liking: the thing liked does the pleasing.
(a él) le / (a mí) me gusta + thing: Me gusta el té.

sentences.en: She likes to run.

sentences.t: A él le gusta el té dulce.
sentences.en: He likes sweet tea.

sentences.t: A Tom le gusta observar aves.
sentences.en: Tom likes to observe birds.

sentences.t: A él le gusta cantar y bailar.
sentences.en: He likes singing and dancing.

sentences.t: A él le gusta la cultura occidental.
sentences.en: He likes Western culture.

sentences.t: A Tom le gusta probar cosas nuevas.
sentences.en: Tom likes trying out new things.

sentences.t: A mí ni siquiera me gusta pelear.
sentences.en: Even I don't like to fight.

label: más … que
note: More than: compares two things.
más + adjective + que: Soy más alto que tú.

sentences.en: I am shorter than you.
You are taller than I.
I'm smarter than you.

sentences.t: Esta pared es más alta que esa.
sentences.en: This wall is taller than that one.

sentences.t: Nada es más valioso que la salud.
sentences.en: Nothing is more valuable than health.

sentences.t: Nada es más precioso que el tiempo.
sentences.en: Nothing is so precious as time.

sentences.t: Este animal es más grande que aquél.
sentences.en: This animal is bigger than that one.

label: tan … como
note: As … as: two things are equal.
tan + adjective + como: Soy tan alto como Tom.

sentences.en: I'm as tall as Tom.

sentences.t: No soy tan idiota como para creerte.
sentences.en: I'm not so stupid as to believe you.

sentences.t: Tom no es tan inteligente como parece.
sentences.en: Tom isn't as smart as he looks.

sentences.t: Nunca probé algo tan extraño como esto.
sentences.en: I've never tasted anything as unusual as this.

sentences.t: Deberías partir tan pronto como sea posible.
sentences.en: You should set off as soon as possible.

label: por / para
en: for: through, because of / to, in order to
note: por: through, by, because of, during.
para: for whom, to where, in order to.

sentences.en: He came in through the window.
I'm looking for a place to sleep.
Thank you for your help.
You're too young to love.
Do you come here often?
He leaves for Tokyo tomorrow.
I am crazy about golf.
What have I done to deserve this?

label: lo
note: It or him: the thing acted on.
lo before the verb: Lo sabe. No lo dije.

sentences.t: Ella lo trataba como a un rey.
sentences.en: She treated him like a king.
Anybody knows it.
He actually did it.
He accomplished it at last.
I meant it as a joke.
In fact, I did not know it.
I know you can make it.

label: se (reflexive)
note: se with the verb: sit down, get up, marry, forget.
se + verb: Tom se lavó. Ella se casó.

sentences.en: He stood up.
She feels bad today.

sentences.t: El juez se rió sin querer.
sentences.en: The judge laughed in spite of himself.

sentences.t: Tom se sentó solo en el bar.
sentences.en: Tom sat alone at the bar.

sentences.t: Ella se casó con un hombre rico.
sentences.en: She married a rich man.

sentences.t: Tom se olvidó de firmar su nombre.
sentences.en: Tom forgot to sign his name.

sentences.t: Ellos se sentaron al lado del fuego.
sentences.en: They sat down by the fire.

label: se (impersonal)
note: One does it: no named doer.
se + verb: Aquí se habla español.

sentences.en: They speak Spanish in Mexico.

sentences.t: ¿Qué lengua se habla en tu país?
sentences.en: What language do they speak in your country?

sentences.t: Este producto no se vende en Japón.
sentences.en: This product isn't sold in Japan.

sentences.t: No recuerdo cómo se usa esta máquina.
sentences.en: I can't remember how to use this machine.

sentences.t: No se puede sobrevivir sin dinero.
sentences.en: You can't survive without money.

sentences.t: No se puede negar que es inteligente.
sentences.en: There is no denying that he is clever.
How can this be accomplished?

label: estar + -ando
note: Is doing it right now.
estar + -ando / -iendo: Está comiendo.

sentences.en: The man is eating bread.
Tom is calling back.
They are reading her book.
He's talking on the telephone.
My wife is trying to sleep.

sentences.t: Tom está pensando en vender su casa.
sentences.en: Tom is thinking of selling his house.

label: ha + participle
note: Has done it, up to now.
ha + -ado / -ido: Tom ha vuelto.

sentences.en: Mom has set the table.

sentences.t: Tom ha vuelto con su ex.
sentences.en: Tom is back with his ex.
She has bought a chicken.

sentences.t: Tom ha perdido su tarjeta de acceso.
sentences.en: Tom has lost his keycard.

sentences.t: Él ha perdido todo su poder político.
sentences.en: He has lost all his political power.
Summer has ended.

sentences.t: Tom ha encontrado una nueva manera de anunciar sus noticias.
sentences.en: Tom has found a new way to announce his news.

label: volver a
note: Do it again.
volver a + verb: Volvió a llamar.

sentences.en: I don't ever want to see you again.
She explained it over again.
Tom apologized again.

sentences.t: Te vuelvo a marcar en una hora.
sentences.en: I'll call you up again in an hour.

sentences.t: No volveré a perdonar tus errores.
sentences.en: I won't excuse your mistakes again.

sentences.t: No vuelvas a cometer el mismo error.
sentences.en: Don't make the same mistake again.

label: no … nada
note: Nothing: keep no before the verb and nada after it.
no + verb + nada: No sé nada. No hice nada.

sentences.en: I know nothing about her.
I don't have anything to declare.
He did nothing wrong.
I can't think of anything.

sentences.t: No hagas nada que vayas a lamentar.
sentences.en: Don't do anything you'll regret.

sentences.t: No te puedo ofrecer nada a cambio.
sentences.en: I can't offer you anything in return.

sentences.t: No le digas nada a la prensa internacional.
sentences.en: Don't say anything to the international press.

label: ayer / hace
note: Yesterday or ago: the past is finished.
Ayer compré. hace un año = a year ago.

sentences.t: Este es el disco que compré ayer.
sentences.en: This is the record which I bought yesterday.

sentences.t: Un desconocido me llamó ayer por teléfono.
sentences.en: A stranger phoned me yesterday.

sentences.t: El programa fue emitido ayer por la radio.
sentences.en: The program was broadcast over the radio yesterday.

sentences.t: Su abuelo murió de cáncer hace un año.
sentences.en: His grandfather died of cancer a year ago.

sentences.t: Fue ascendido a coronel hace dos años.
sentences.en: He was promoted to colonel two years ago.

sentences.t: La escuela se fundó hace setenta años.
sentences.en: The school was founded seventy years ago.

sentences.t: La primera edición se publicó hace diez años.
sentences.en: The first edition was published ten years ago.

label: fue + participle
note: Was done by someone: the passive.
fue + -ado / -ido + por: Fue mordida por un animal.

sentences.t: La ciudad fue destruida por el fuego.
sentences.en: The city was destroyed by fire.

sentences.t: Ayer la casa fue golpeada por un rayo.
sentences.en: The house was struck by lightning yesterday.

sentences.t: Su acción fue guiada por nobles ideas.
sentences.en: His act was animated by noble ideals.

sentences.t: Mucha gente fue engañada por ese anuncio.
sentences.en: Many people were deceived by the advertisement.

sentences.t: El campeón fue recibido por una enorme multitud.
sentences.en: The champion was welcomed by large crowds.

label: si + past subjunctive
note: Imagined if: what would happen.
si + -ara / -iera, then -ría: Si pudiera, iría.

sentences.t: ¿Qué haría usted si perdiese su empleo?
sentences.en: What would you do if you lost your job?

sentences.t: ¡Sería genial si pudiera hablar diez idiomas!
sentences.en: It would be so cool if I could speak ten languages!

sentences.t: Ella parecía como si hubiera visto un fantasma.
sentences.en: She looked as if she had seen a ghost.

sentences.t: Este chico habla como si fuera un adulto.
sentences.en: That boy talks as if he were a grown up.

sentences.t: Aprendería a bailar si tuviera más tiempo.
sentences.en: I would learn how to dance if I had more time.

sentences.t: Saldría seguido y me divertiría si tuviera dinero.
sentences.en: I would often go out and have fun if I had the money.

sentences.t: Probablemente estarías más sano si comieras menos hamburguesas.
sentences.en: You'd probably be healthier if you ate fewer burgers.

label: cuando + subjunctive
note: When, for something that has not happened yet.
cuando + subjunctive: cuando tengas tiempo.

sentences.en: We'll do it when we have time.
We will begin the match when he comes.

sentences.t: Pregunta al profesor cuando tengas una duda.
sentences.en: Ask the teacher when you have a question.

sentences.t: Di la verdad cuando quieras engañar al mundo.
sentences.en: Tell the truth when you want to fool the world.

sentences.t: Te voy a extrañar mucho cuando te vayas.
sentences.en: I'll miss you very much when you go.

label: que + subjunctive
note: After need, doubt or it is possible: subjunctive.
Es posible que llueva. Necesito que vengas.

sentences.t: Necesito que él me dé su apoyo.
sentences.en: I need him to vouch for me.

sentences.t: Necesito que le eches un vistazo a esto.
sentences.en: I need you to take a look at this.
It may rain tomorrow.

sentences.t: No es necesario que asistamos a la conferencia.
sentences.en: We don't need to attend that meeting.

sentences.t: Pienso que es importante que mantengamos la calma.
sentences.en: I think it important that we should keep calm.

sentences.t: No creo que sea raro en absoluto.
sentences.en: I don't think it's weird at all.

label: al + infinitive
note: On doing something: at that moment.
al + verb: Al caer, se lastimó.

sentences.t: Hay un hotel al cruzar la calle.
sentences.en: There's a hotel across the street.

sentences.t: Cometiste un error al rechazar su ayuda.
sentences.en: You were wrong to refuse his help.

sentences.t: Justo al colgar el teléfono, volvió a sonar.
sentences.en: No sooner had I hung up than the phone started ringing again.

sentences.t: No pude resistir reírme al verlo bailar.
sentences.en: I could not help laughing to see him dancing.

sentences.t: Incluso los japoneses pueden equivocarse al hablar japonés.
sentences.en: Even Japanese can make mistakes when they speak Japanese.

label: ya / todavía
note: Already or no longer, versus still.
ya no = no longer; todavía = still.

sentences.en: He should have arrived already.
Has the movie started yet?

sentences.t: La famosa huella de Neil Armstrong está todavía justo donde la dejó.
sentences.en: Neil Armstrong's famous footprint is still right where he left it.

sentences.t: ¿Has leído ya el diario de hoy?
sentences.en: Have you read today's paper yet?

sentences.t: El gato desaparecido todavía no se ha encontrado.
sentences.en: The missing cat has not been found yet.

sentences.t: ¿Has terminado ya de limpiar tu habitación?
sentences.en: Have you finished cleaning your room yet?
